exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: cohort.minimum_ten_surveys: exclude participants with fewer than 10 personality-state surveys

inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer personality-state-survey count per participant.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant only when the supplied count is strictly below 10; retain equality and larger counts.
limitations: This binding does not identify or deduplicate personality-state survey records.
This binding does not group survey records or derive participant-level counts.
A missing participant count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
